'''Womp Rat fever''' was the common name for the disease carried by some [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]]. If untreated it was fatal. The experimental [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] [[VX-736 injector]] cured Womp Rat fever and made the user temporarily immune for seven [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].<ref name="TOR" />
